items.title: Atomic Puppet Episode 4: Justice Alliance / Bad Lair Day
items.description:
The Justice Alliance comes to town seeking to replace the vacancy left by Captain Atomic.

Joey and AP pay a visit to the old Captain Atomic Headquarters.

items.title: Atomic Puppet Episode 3: Pizza Planet / Don't Track the Mudman
items.description:
When a new alien-themed restaurant opens, Joey suspects the hosts are not what they seem.
